extensions.name: Change Case
extensions.description: Change the case of the selection or document: upper, lower, title, snake_case, kebab-case, camelCase, PascalCase and CONSTANT_CASE.
extensions.readme:
# Change Case

Change the case of the selection or document: upper, lower, title, snake_case, kebab-case, camelCase, PascalCase and CONSTANT_CASE.

Works on the selection, or on the whole document when nothing is selected:

- **Upper Case**: what it does.
- **Lower Case**: what it does.
- **Title Case**: what it does.
- **snake_case**: what it does.
- **kebab-case**: what it does.
- **camelCase**: what it does.
- **PascalCase**: what it does.
- **CONSTANT_CASE**: what it does.

Reads and replaces the text you give it. Nothing else: no files, no
network.

extensions.name: Sort Lines
extensions.description: Sort the selected lines, or the whole document, and remove duplicates.
extensions.readme:
# Sort Lines

Three commands on the selection, or on the whole document when nothing is
selected:

- **Sort Lines**: A to Z, by Unicode code point.
- **Sort Lines Descending**: Z to A.
- **Remove Duplicate Lines**: keeps the first of each, in order.

Reads and replaces the text you give it. Nothing else: no files, no
network.
